title: Ash & Iron Glaze Swatch Zine
description: A 24-page saddle-stitched booklet photographing twelve wood-ash and iron glaze tests from our studio kiln, paired with handwritten firing notes on uncoated linen paper.
blurbs: Twelve wood-ash glaze tests straight from our cone 10 notebook.
Compact 24-page field guide to clay bodies, ash ratios, and kiln moods.
evidence: img_02: studio glaze test tiles laid out on pine board

title: Cone 10 Throwing & Trimming Notes
description: A downloadable 48-page studio manual detailing wall thickness charts, foot-ring profiles, and slow cooling curves used across Kestrel & Clay vessels.
blurbs: My bench measurements for balanced rims, crisp foot rings, and clean pours.
Instant PDF download with printable wall-thickness templates and kiln logs.
evidence: voice_1: shares kiln unloading temperatures and glaze notes openly

title: Weekend Kiln Loading & Glaze Session
description: Spend a small-group afternoon glazing three bisque-fired pieces in studio wood ash, stacking the reduction kiln together, and reviewing test draw-rings.
blurbs: Glaze three stoneware forms beside me and learn how placement shapes the finish.
Includes three bisque vessels, ash glazes, and finished firing pickup.
evidence: voice_2: invites collectors into studio glaze choices

title: Speckled Stoneware Espresso Cup
description: A four-ounce handless espresso tumbler wheel-thrown from warm iron-speckled clay, dipped in satin oat ash glaze with a raw unglazed foot.
blurbs: Pulled from cone 10 reduction with warm iron speckles along every rim.
Four-ounce stoneware cup that holds heat well past the last sip.
evidence: img_01: stoneware espresso cups cooling on oak table

title: Fluted Ash-Glaze Pour-Over Dripper
description: Wheel-thrown cone-02 stoneware dripper with hand-carved interior ribs for steady airflow and a wide base flange that sits cleanly on mugs or carafes.
blurbs: Hand-carved inner flutes inspired by carved studio grid lines.
Fits standard #02 paper filters and retains brewing heat without preheating fuss.
evidence: img_03: fluted stoneware pour-over brewer on studio counter

title: Bespoke Four-Piece Coffee Table Set
description: A made-to-order morning set: two mugs, one pour-over dripper, and one matching carafe, glazed in your choice of three studio ash finishes and thrown together in one firing.
blurbs: Thrown as a single family from one wedge of speckled clay and fired side by side.
Includes a 20-minute glaze selection call and signed firing log card.
evidence: voice_2: collaborates directly with collectors on glaze choices

title: Kiln Shelf Study Postcard Folio
description: Six letterpress-textured postcards reproducing studio woodblock rubbings of kiln drip rings and cone marks, wrapped in a stamped linen belly band.
blurbs: Six tactile studies of wood-ash rings left behind on the kiln shelf.
Frameable A6 cards printed on heavy 300 gsm cotton rag stock.
evidence: img_05: ink rubbings of kiln shelf rings

title: Numbered Woodblock Kiln Grid Print
description: Hand-burnished two-block woodcut printed with iron oxide and soot ink onto Japanese kozo paper, mapping the stacked geometry of a freshly unloaded reduction kiln.
blurbs: Carved in birch and burnished by hand with iron-oxide studio ink.
Signed A3 edition on deckle-edge kozo paper, ready for standard framing.
evidence: img_05: hand-carved grid woodblock proof on studio wall

title: Reduction-Fired Basalt Neck Vessel
description: A tall hand-coiled and wheel-finished sculptural vessel made from iron-rich black stoneware, finished with a natural collar of melted birch ash.
blurbs: One-off blackened basalt form with a natural melted birch-ash shoulder.
Stands 28 cm tall with sealed interior suitable for dry branches or water.
